$comment: D-1 phase 4 admission, 2026-11-21 (owner decision: merge panels/autoPanels/backOffice into screens/experiences). One slot (experiences[].admin) whose body is $defs/backOffice ({locale, strings, defaultRoute, navigation, pages}, unchanged). It replaces the removed root key `backOffice` and a pack's `backOffice` (a pack declares only `pages` in its own experiences[] admin entry; pack:backOffice is out). The compiled model (settings, appShell, guidePages) is unchanged.

declarative.why: the back office is the admin experience: an experiences[] entry {name: admin, admin: {...}} names the language and text overrides, the route the back office opens on, the menu entries (label, target, group) and the dashboard pages; nothing is computed

notLower.why: the menu and the dashboard layout are structure the generated shell renders; no expression, function or step can say which entry opens first or which gadget sits in which region -- and a pack needs a place to contribute its own dashboard pages that survives composition (qualified pack::Page names)

twice.note: both apps configure their back office this way (it was their root `backOffice`); the labeling pack (NPDevSamples/dsl-conformance-max/Input/packs/labeling) contributes pages through its own admin entry

enforced.note: AdminExperienceTest refuses the removed root/pack backOffice key and a second admin entry, composes a pack's pages (pack::Page after the model's own) into one admin entry, and compiles the entry to the same appShell/settings/guidePages as before; BusinessUiEmitterAppShellManifestTest fails if defaultRoute/navigation/pages stop reaching the generated UI manifest

taught.bundleLine: `experiences[]` entry `{"name":"admin","admin":{"locale":"pt-BR","strings":{..},"defaultRoute":"<Concept>","navigation":[{"label":"..","target":"<Concept>","group":".."}],"pages":[<guide pages>]}}` (OPTIONAL, at most one -- omit it unless you want a grouped menu, your own dashboards or your own wording)
